high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the "Mint" section of a news website. The headline reads: "Will India's stock markets accept a loss-making company going public, and learn to value tech companies like private investors do? This question was emphatically answered with 13-year-old food tech start-up Zomato's blockbuster IPO last month." The article discusses the successful Initial Public Offering (IPO) of Zomato, a 13-year-old food technology startup. It mentions that the stock listed at Rs76 per share and rose on listing, closing on Monday at Rs138.4
